To prepare a corpus for a reliable NovaLearn deployment, the customer should follow the Phase 2 corpus preparation process in collaboration with NovaLearn Implementation Leads and the customer’s content owners [NL-005#NL-005-S04]. This includes:

- **Document Source Audit**: Identify where knowledge is stored (e.g., SharePoint, Google Drive, local servers, Confluence), catalog file formats, and document the volume of files in each repository [NL-005#NL-005-S04].
- **Format Inspection**: Verify documents are in supported formats (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, HTML, Markdown, CSV, XLSX); flag legacy or unsupported formats for conversion [NL-005#NL-005-S04].
- **OCR Identification**: Scan the corpus to find image-only or scanned PDFs; flag them for OCR processing. Scanned PDFs require OCR for reliable citations and may extend the onboarding timeline [NL-005#NL-005-S04].
- **Document Taxonomy Definition**: Design the tagging system (e.g., department, product, region) and set up custom metadata schemas to enable filtering and retrieval [NL-005#NL-005-S04].
- **Corpus Audit Checklist Verification**: Before delivering the Corpus Inventory Sheet, content owners must verify file names are descriptive and exclude special symbols, there are no duplicate policy manuals, scanned files are separated and marked "OCR Required: True", every document has an assigned department and owner, and source files contain clear heading structures (H1, H2, H3) [NL-005#NL-005-S04].

This corpus preparation is part of the broader onboarding methodology that includes auditing the knowledge base, cleaning stale documentation, and structuring permission groups before a controlled pilot [NL-005#NL-005-S01].
